items.question: Are the generated designs really unique?
items.answer: Yes. Unlike template libraries, Lovart generates each image from scratch based on your specific prompt using AI, ensuring your design is one-of-a-kind.

items.question: Can I edit the text on the generated images?
items.answer: Absolutely. Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature allows you to click on any text in the generated image and rewrite it, change the font, or fix typos instantly.

items.question: Can I use these posts for Facebook Ads?
items.answer: Yes. All assets generated on paid plans come with a full commercial license, making them safe for use in Facebook Ads and other marketing campaigns.

items.question: What sizes does Lovart support?
items.answer: Lovart supports all standard Facebook sizes, including Square (1:1), Portrait (4:5), Landscape (16:9), and Story (9:16). You can also use Smart Resize to adapt one design to multiple sizes.

items.question: Can I upload my own product images?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload your product photo and use the 'Edit Elements' or background replacement features to integrate it seamlessly into the AI-generated design.
